title: Custom Block Loot
description: Changing the items each block will give when mined with more helpful options
body:
💎 CustomBlockLoot | Ultimate In-Game Loot Editor [1.21+]
CustomBlockLoot is a powerful, lightweight, and highly intuitive Minecraft plugin that allows server administrators to completely redesign and customize block drops directly from an elegant in-game Graphical User Interface (GUI).

Say goodbye to tedious configurations, syntax errors, and restarting your server just to change a single block drop. With this plugin, if you can hold it in your hand, you can make a block drop it!

✨ Features
🛠️ 100% In-Game GUI Editor: Modify any block's loot table dynamically without ever touching a .yml file.

📦 Full Data Component & NBT Support: Safely remembers everything about the items you configure—including Custom Names, Lore, Enchants, Potion Effects, and CustomModelData.

🍀 Smart Fortune Toggle: Choose whether the Minecraft Fortune enchantment affects your custom drops using an integrated smart calculator.

🧲 Integrated Auto-Pickup Toggle: Decide on a per-block basis whether drops should scatter naturally on the ground or be sucked directly into the player's inventory.

🛡️ Inventory Overflow Protection: If Auto-Pickup is enabled but a player's inventory is completely full, items will safely drop at their feet instead of vanishing.

🎨 Premium Aesthetic: Features stunning modern HEX colors, smooth gradients, custom UI audio cues, and strict prevention of accidental item duplication or icon grabbing.

⚡ Highly Optimized: Engineered to run smoothly on modern 1.21+ architectures (Spigot, Paper, Purpur) with zero performance impact.

📸 How It Works & UI Guide
Using the plugin is incredibly simple:

Run the command /changeloot <block_type> (e.g., /changeloot diamond_ore).

An elegant 54-slot chest menu will open up.

Drag and drop any custom items you want this block to yield upon destruction into the top slots.

Configure your toggles at the bottom right:

🟩 / 🟥 Fortune Button: Left-click to switch between Enabled (multiplies custom drops based on tool level) and Disabled (yields static drop counts).

🪝 / ❌ Auto-Pickup Button: Left-click to alternate between Inventory Delivery (sends drops straight to the miner) and Ground Drops (classic Minecraft mechanics).

Close the inventory. Your settings are instantly saved and active!

💻 Commands & Permissions
Command	Description	Permission
/changeloot <block>	Opens the visual loot table editor for the specified block.	customblockloot.admin
⚠️ Note: The permission node defaults to server operators (OP) if no permission manager is installed.

🚀 Installation
Download the CustomBlockLoot.jar file.

Drop it into your server's plugins folder.

Ensure your server is running Java 21 and Minecraft 1.21 or newer.

Restart your server, and you are ready to create magic!
